f1c_cleared_vs_plan.question: Does the DAM-CLEARED AS quantity ever exceed the published plan (the second admissible reading of waiver W-3 category (i))?
f1c_cleared_vs_plan.verdict: MEASURED ZERO — RegUp, ECRS and NSPIN cleared EXACTLY the plan in all 8760 hours (0 hours above, 0 below, max|Δ| = 0.0); RRS cleared BELOW plan in all 8760 hours (mean 1822 vs plan 2903 MW; even the least-short hour is 422 MW under). The DAM never procured more than planned, so max(plan, cleared) ≡ plan and F1c's arm is bit-identical to F1's by construction — covered by this solve, no separate probe.

G-SHORTFALL.rule: per rigid family, arm shortfall hour-set ⊆ control's (precommit AMENDMENT 1 — no MANUFACTURED shortage; the keeper baseline itself carries 21 designed VOLL-engagement hours)

d4.note: the arm's D-4 FAIL rows (chp_steam, reliability_floor × CT_PEAKER, st_netload_drag, gas_commitment_bridge × CC_REGULAR) are the keeper's OWN inherited rows, present identically in the control; F1 introduces none.

verdict.statement: F1 is REJECTED for adoption on a measured-null, not on a gate failure. Every gate passes and nothing degrades — the mechanism is simply an identity on 2023 data. The object it was built to capture DOES NOT EXIST at material scale: ERCOT's telemetered real-time AS responsibility exceeds its own published AS plan in 2 hours of 8760, by ≤8.3 MW, and its DAM clears never exceed plan at all. The keeper's plan-based requirement is ALREADY the ceiling of the measured 2023 procurement conservatism.
verdict.structural_reading: This is the direct measured refutation of the held-DEPTH reading of the ercot-217 §5 wedge (RESEARCH-ercot218b §4). Combined with ercot-226's F2 rejection (held-LOCATION: built, armed, and rejected — the conserving class carve RELIEVES the system withheld families and costs net scarcity expression), the ~2.7 GW wedge is now measured to be NEITHER a mis-SIZED nor a mis-LOCATED AS carve. The AS-sequestration channel is closed as an explanation for the 2023 summer miss; the remaining live surface is the energy/tightness channel outside AS procurement.

do_not_redo: F1 (held-depth, any product) and F1c (cleared-vs-plan) are adjudicated by MEASUREMENT plus a confirming solve. Do not re-open without a NEW measured driver — a different telemetry basis or a corrected plan series, cited by name.
